title: Particle item effect outcome
description: Spawns a particle in the world using the given parameters. Some of the parameters may have different effects depending on the particle type.

particle.$comment: A particle definition, most particles only require the 'type' field.

position.$comment: The position to spawn the particle at.

count.$comment: The number of particles to spawn.

speed.$comment: The initial speed of the particles, effect tends to vary depending on particle type.

spread.$comment: A vector typically defining a space of allowed difference in initial particle speed, effects tends to vary depending on particle type.
